name: Dr. Kavita Patidar
education: B.Sc., LL.B., M.A., Honorary Doctorate Degree awarded by the U.G.C. Educated at Government Post Graduate College, Mhow, Indore and P.M.B. Gujarati Arts and Law College, Indore, Madhya Pradesh
present_address: Flat No. B-8, Tower A2, Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Marg New Delhi- 110002
permanent_address: 1464, Anand Nagar, Near Govt. College, Dr. Ambedkar Nagar (Mhow), Indore (M.P.) 453411
social_activities: Instrumental in making 312 Gram Panchayats of 4 District Panchayats of Indore district open defecation free in a time bound programme; Indore district was declared first open defecation free district in the State and second in the country under the Swachh Bharat Mission; involved in water conservation and development campaign in Indore district (rural); 243 large and small ponds of the district were deepened with the cooperation of people by devising a strategy for harvesting of rain water for water conservation and development; large number of peoples' representatives, local farmers, intellectuals and voluntary organizations participated in this campaign; as a result of this campaign, about 29.75 lakh cubic meter (8.5 lakh trolley soil) was dug up from 243 ponds which benefitted about 21 farmers; farmers were motivated to use the dug up soil of the ponds and drains in their fields; involved in the work of establishing libraries in 50 Government High Schools and Higher Secondary Schools with a collection of qualitative and informative books for the rural students; involved in creating awareness in the patidar majority districts of Madhya Pradesh by organizing small conferences for adopting the public welfare scheme, the "Beti Bachao Abhiyan" of Government of Madhya Pradesh on priority basis; around 10,000 women of the Patidar samaj took pledge under the Beti Bachao Abhiyan on 6 December, 2011 at the Umiyadham Complex, Rau, district Indore; formed women's organizations at the village level in 27 districts, organized, (i) women's conferences on a large scale, (ii) familiarization conferences, (iii) multi-purpose programs at Keshod (Sidsar, Jamjodhpur, Ahmedabad, Unjha) of Gujarat, Jalgaon (Maharashtra), Jhalawar, (Rajasthan), etc. for the cause of social upliftment and creating awareness among the Patidar samaj; was State President, Patidar Samaj (M.P.); Trustee, Shree Umiya Mataji Sansthan, Unjha (Gujarat)
other_information: President, B.J.P. Mandal, 2006-08; District Vice-President, B.J.P., Indore, 2009-2012; State Secretary, B.J.P. (Madhya Pradesh), 2016-2020, General Secretary, B.J.P. (Madhya Pradesh) since 2020; State Incharge, (i) Bharatiya Janata Yuva Morcha, B.J.P. (Madhya Pradesh) since 2020, (ii) Bharatiya Janata Mahila Morcha, B.J.P. (Madhya Pradesh) since 2020 and (iii) Jabalpur Sambhag, B.J.P. (Madhya Pradesh) since 2021; was conferred (i) Best Zila Adhyaksh Award and (ii) Panchayat Sashktikaran Award (2016)
